note: Chance a ruled-out skill player plays each of his team's next games, for players ruled 'Out' on the injury report ('curves'; reserve lists are under 'lists') and by games already missed in a row (3 = three or more). 'played' is the measured share; 'relative' divides by the share of healthy players who play the same game and never decreases. Players averaging 6+ PPR points over their last 8 games. Fit on 2019-2023 only; checked on 2024 and 2025 (work/injury_return, report in Drive reports/injury-return-fade.md).

lists.note: Injured reserve, PUP and NFI under the rules in force since 2022: a player must miss at least 4 games on the list. 'played' is the share who play, 'n' the cases, by games since he was first allowed back ('inside': still inside his minimum stay when ruled out) or by games ahead ('past1to2', 'past3plus': still on the list 1-2 or 3+ games after he could have returned). Rising curves only. Fit on 2022-2023 (IR roster codes R01/R48, 93 stints); checked on 2024 and 2025. The chance used is 'played' divided by the healthy rate for that many games ahead.
